subject.title: fix(cron): cap trigger script tool access

question: How should OpenClaw handle pre-existing trigger-script jobs that lack toolsAllow because their creator's historical tool policy was never persisted?
rationale: The patch cannot reconstruct a trustworthy cap for legacy rows; preserving them retains the known broad tool surface, while failing closed can break existing automation.

options.title: Audit legacy jobs
options.body: Merge the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped trigger jobs and provides explicit operator remediation.

options.title: Accept forward-only coverage
options.body: Merge while explicitly accepting that pre-existing uncapped triggers remain unrestricted until an authorized edit restamps them.

options.title: Fail closed
options.body: Block legacy uncapped trigger evaluation until an operator assigns policy, accepting immediate compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Audit legacy jobs
recommendation.body: Merge the forward fix with a doctor or startup audit that lists uncapped trigger jobs and provides explicit operator remediation.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current creator-cap behavior and is the clearest history-backed owner for its security and upgrade policy.
